historical_test_policy: diagnostic origin only; never refit, resplit, select, or claim new validation on it
new_holdout_policy: exclude ALL old candidate and pilot exposure components; future time/source/campaign specification before collection; no outcome-driven replacement

review.uncertain_policy: quarantine, retain denominator, no automatic relabel

sample_design.reference_stream: representative new cohort; retain observed prevalence and collection failures
sample_design.targeted_stream: simple benign, complex phishing and benign login; report separately from reference stream
sample_design.complexity_cutpoints: fit training tag_count quartiles; retain historical thresholds only for old review

experiments.selection: inner group CV only; primary mean F1, ties within 0.005 prefer lower benign FPR then lower complexity; report all outer results
experiments.calibration: only group-disjoint training folds; SVC built-in probability CV disabled
experiments.uncertainty: paired whole-leakage-component bootstrap; repeated seed SD is not a confidence interval
experiments.operating_thresholds: set on training calibration/inner validation only; operational FPR targets must be fixed before new external evaluation

promotion.note: provisional research effect/guardrail targets, not deployment standards; lock with cohort before scores; failure/inconclusive keeps stage open
